name: leadgenerator
description: Evidence-backed B2B lead sourcing, qualification, contact enrichment, and confirmed HubSpot synchronization.

interface.shortDescription: Source, enrich and sync reviewed B2B leads.
interface.longDescription: Lead Generator routes each request to a persistent objective agent, stores reviewed company records in private local PostgreSQL memory, then presents sourced companies, decision-makers, guarded Enrow-to-FullEnrich enrichment, and verified HubSpot synchronization.
capabilities: Versioned micro-kernel and independently replaceable native capabilities
Private declarative client packs with validated composition and rollback
Configurable native UI, declarative panels, and replaceable two-surface UI shells
Quarantined isolated client extensions with explicit permissions
Fullscreen lead maps with optional ephemeral device geolocation
Persistent objective agents and document context
Read-only LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Facebook, and Instagram research through explicitly approved local sessions
Private PostgreSQL company memory, immutable history, and readable export
Immutable evidence, observations, explainable scores, and reviewed outcomes
Public-only professional profile discovery with coverage-aware top-five ranking
Independently evidenced profile photos and dated public post summaries
Confirmed HubSpot company association, list, and owner assignment
defaultPrompt: Crée un objectif industriel dans les Hauts-de-France et affiche le parcours Lead Generator.
Trouve des entreprises pour le code NAF 62.01Z et affiche l'explorateur interactif.
Qualifie ma sélection et affiche les contacts, visuels et étapes HubSpot.
